stealthcraft.midnightconfig.title: Stealthcraft
stealthcraft.midnightconfig.seenMode.too: Controls what happens once fully noticed by an entity.
stealthcraft.midnightconfig.damageMode.t: Controls in what way the player will be damaged once noticed.
stealthcraft.midnightconfig.damageAmount: The amount of damage to deal when the player is noticed.
stealthcraft.midnightconfig.targetMode.t: Which entities should start targeting the player when noticed.
For how many ticks mobs that have been alerted of the player will target them for.
stealthcraft.midnightconfig.targetRadius: In what range mobs should be alerted of the player when they are seen by another mob.
stealthcraft.midnightconfig.minDetection: How many ticks it should take at minimum for a mob to detect a player.
stealthcraft.midnightconfig.entityGoalTw: Controls if entity goals should be tweaked to avoid possibly frustrating behavior (such as entities looking at the player).
